Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent game decoration sprite atlas.
Create EXACTLY a square 2 by 2 grid of four separate small decoration sprites, row-major order: top-left 0 a single ivory curved bone rib; top-right 1 a single ivory pointed bone spike with a small slate stone base; bottom-left 2 a low slate rock cluster with one tiny amber fissure; bottom-right 3 a short teal crystalline growth.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: environment_carapace-cohesive-v03.png provides warm ivory bone, slate stone, amber fissures and teal accents; enemy_skitter_walk.png provides crisp 16-bit-inspired grouped pixel shading. Do not copy the full environment or monsters.
Style: polished 16-bit-inspired crisp grouped pixels with hard stepped pixel edges, limited warm ivory/slate/amber/teal palette, elevated three-quarter overhead game camera, upper-left light. Bone segmented surfaces, slate faceted blocks, teal small short crystals.
Atlas geometry: four equal square cells in an EXACT 2x2 arrangement. Each object is small, no more than 60% of its cell width and height. Each sprite is horizontally centered; its bottom ground-contact/feet anchor is at exactly cell x=50%, y=80%. Keep generous clear transparent margins between every sprite and every outer edge. No sprite crosses cells.
Background: actual fully transparent RGBA empty background, not a painted checkerboard. No floor plane, no ground patch, no halo, no glow, no cast shadow, no UI, no text, no grid lines, no characters, no scenery. Exactly these four isolated objects only.
CRITICAL SMALL-SPRITE LAYOUT: previous layout was invalid because bones were far too tall. Make ALL FOUR objects tiny thumbnail sprites occupying only 35% of cell width and 45% of cell height, with their BOTTOM at 80% cell height. On a 1024x1024 conceptual canvas: top-left object entirely inside x=160..352,y=170..410; top-right inside x=672..864,y=170..410; bottom-left inside x=160..352,y=682..922; bottom-right inside x=672..864,y=682..922. EMPTY TRANSPARENT CROSS between four quadrants, especially y=460..560 absolutely empty. Every sprite must fit entirely inside its assigned rectangle. Bone rib and spike are short, compact, small props. Wide blank transparent margins are essential.
